verdict.rationale: Abacum's own materials say it connects ERP, CRM, and HRIS data into one governed source of truth. They describe connecting the HRIS to plan each new hire and planning headcount in the same connected model as the budget. Pipeline, actuals, and capacity are also said to sit in one live model alongside ERP-driven books. Missing for 10: explicit payroll-system connectors, a named list of supported CRM/HRIS integrations, documentation of sync depth or frequency and field mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a launch-thread mention of integration toggles and data-mapping menus.
